about: Brockville is a city on the St. Lawrence River in eastern Ontario, at the gateway to the Thousand Islands. It is one of Ontario’s oldest incorporated cities, with a limestone downtown, river tunnel, and blockhouse heritage facing the shipping channel. The city serves as a local service centre between Kingston and Cornwall. About 22,000 people live in Brockville.
